body:
Step 3 of docs/ios-port-design.md. The iOS shell: an Xcode project (ios/) that hosts the shared UI
in a UIViewController (startIosApp() and MainViewController() from :shared's iosMain, T-349),
built, linked and run in the simulator on the maintainer's macOS guest (OSX-KVM, Intel, Xcode
16.2; the simulator is x86_64, so the iosX64 target of T-373). Hosted CI, signing for a device and
TestFlight are T-355. First milestone: log in, overview, open a list, add and check items, sync
while open, multi-account as on Android — against a server run on the guest, its self-signed
certificate trusted by the simulator (simctl keychain add-root-cert). Update the design doc's
"No Mac" decision and the module table's ios/ row.
title: iPhone port step 3: the iOS shell, built and run in the simulator on the macOS guest
